attempts.attempt_policy: One attempt under this corrective contract, on its distinct exact nodeid. The prior v1 attempt remains immutable; any further attempt requires another classified source/instrumentation change or a separately defined hypothesis and contract.

corrective_change.change: Instantiate Hex8SRIElement directly, validate its Gauss geometry, scatter each local stiffness matrix into a global dense matrix exactly as in the J10 diagnostic, and solve that frozen global system by NumPy, scaling, SciPy and mpmath.
corrective_change.demonstrated_cause: FiniteElementModel.dof_manager rejects HEX8_SRI because the research-only Hex8SRIElement is intentionally absent from ElementRegistry.
corrective_change.historical_status: The original attempt remains PYTEST_FAILED and is not reclassified.

criteria.archived_state_reproduction_bound: Relative displacement difference <=1e-10 from the J10 alpha=0 archived state; this checks route reproduction only, not physical accuracy.
criteria.criteria: No new pass threshold for physical correctness. Positive finite Gauss Jacobians and matrix reproduction are source/reproduction checks; residuals, conditioning and solver differences remain descriptive. Historical J7 FAIL and J10 exploratory status remain unchanged.
indicators: relative Frobenius delta from each archived J10 global matrix
condition number before and after symmetric diagonal scaling
relative displacement differences among NumPy direct, scaled NumPy, SciPy and mpmath at alpha=0
reaction force and moment closure about the global origin

criteria.reassembly_bound: Relative Frobenius difference <=1e-12 from the J10 archived matrix is a route-reproduction check, not a mechanical-accuracy criterion.

indicators_and_criteria.criteria: No new pass threshold for physical correctness. Solver result status, reproduction bounds and finite quantities are reported; historical J7 FAIL and J10 exploratory status remain unchanged.
indicators: relative displacement differences between same-matrix routes

indicators_and_criteria.reassembly_bound: Relative Frobenius difference <=1e-12 from the J10 archived matrix is a source-reproduction check, not a mechanical-accuracy criterion.

model_and_comparisons.alpha_geometry_operation: Move only the three archived interior nodes selected by the J10 definition in global z by alpha*0.04*sin(pi*x/20); reuse the archived load and fixed DOF arrays bit for bit.
model_and_comparisons.equilibrium_definition: Nodal force resultant and moment about the global origin from cross(r,f), with units N and N·m; also report free residual backward error and norms.
model_and_comparisons.global_matrix_source: Direct element-to-global scatter of QF Hex8SRIElement stiffnesses; alpha=0 and each deformed alpha matrix are checked against the corresponding J10 archived matrix with relative Frobenius bound 1e-12.
model_and_comparisons.historical_comparison: At alpha=0 compare QF GlobalAssembler matrix and solve state with bitwise-input archived J10 arrays and retain the J7 historical FAIL without edits.
model_and_comparisons.historical_comparisons: At alpha=0 compare reassembled matrix and solution to both the archived J10 alpha=0 state and the historical J7 source arrays; keep all J7/J10 statuses unchanged.
primary_routes: QF research-only Hex8SRIElement local stiffness matrices scattered into a global matrix using the J10 route (no production AnalysisRouter/GlobalAssembler status claim)
NumPy direct solve, NumPy symmetric diagonal scaling, SciPy symmetric direct solve, and mpmath 80-digit solve on the same free-free matrix at alpha=0
model_and_comparisons.residual_definition: K*u-f; free DOFs from archived fixed mask; constrained reactions are residual entries at fixed DOFs.

resources.limits_semantics: Runner watchdog, sampled process/RSS/temp/archive and free disk are procedural/soft observations except output byte caps; no OS memory quota is claimed.

scope.explicit_non_claim: HEX8-SRI is not registered as a public QF element type, and GlobalAssembler/AnalysisRouter cannot route it as a production model. This diagnostic reproduces the prior J10 research-kernel global scatter and compares linear-system solution routes only; it is not a production solve or an independent mechanical reference.
scope.hypothesis: The J7 matrices can be independently reassembled from the actual QF research-only Hex8SRIElement kernel using the archived J10 element-to-global scatter route, then compared across numerical solvers on the identical global system.
scope.input_source: Immutable J10 archive of J7/J10 matrices, displacement states, original geometry/connectivity, load vector and fixed DOF mask; J10 script is also frozen as the reference for the research-only element-to-global scatter procedure.

status: Exploratory only; no qualification or acceptance claim.

supersedes.reason: The original exact-node attempt PYTEST_FAILED before assembly because HEX8_SRI is not an accepted registered element type. Repository inspection confirms the supported route is the research-only Hex8SRIElement with J10-style local-to-global scatter.
